title: Owlshift ticket review
description:
A ticket's review record, in [`REVIEW_FILE`](crate::refs::REVIEW_FILE):
each review pass with its findings and what became of them, and the pull
request reviews answered.

answered_reviews.description: The ids of the pull request reviews answered, each once.

build.description:
What the Build that Verify reviews gave for its delivery (OWL-304):
kept once a Build is done and its gate passed, so that `continue`
runs a Verify pass cut short again and delivers. Dropped when the
ticket is delivered or dispatched again from Ready.

format.description: The format version of this document.

Decision.description: A decision the role took on its own.

basis.description: What the decision rests on: the ticket, the code, the docs, a fact.

Finding.description:
A finding of a review run (architecture section 5, "Design review").
Every text is not blank.

criterion.description: The success criterion it bears on, if any.

evidence.description:
What shows it: a `file:line`, a step of the plan, a line of the
ticket.

FindingId.description: A review finding's identifier: F1, F2, and so on.

oneOf.description: The arbiter or the author rejected it.
It went to the decider in a question round.

Followup.description: A follow-up ticket proposed to a human.

blocked_by_parent.description: Whether the follow-up waits for the current ticket to be done.

done_when.description: When the follow-up counts as done.

Harness.description: A harness: a vendor CLI that runs one role headless.

KeptBuild.description:
What a Build gave for its delivery, kept while Verify reviews it
(OWL-304, [`TicketReview::build`]): what the push, the pull request and
the DELIVERY report take, gathered over the delivery's Build runs.

commit.description:
The commit the runner's gate passed on, a full commit id: what is
pushed.

followups.description:
The follow-ups the delivery's Build runs proposed, then those its
Verify passes proposed from findings.

gate.description: The project gate's commands, all passed.

notes.description:
The runner's own notes the report lists, such as the late comments a
Build run was given (OWL-139).

pr.description: The pull request the Build run proposed.

seen.description:
The newest edit of the decider's comments the Build run's brief
held, when it held one: a comment of theirs edited later is one the
Build did not see (OWL-139).

KeptFinding.description: A finding as the ticket ref keeps it.

outcome.description: What became of it, once settled.

response.description:
The author's response (`pipeline.findings = "author"`); never with a
ruling.

ruling.description:
The arbiter's ruling (`pipeline.findings = "arbiter"`); never with a
response.

KeptResponse.description: The author's response, as kept with its finding.

KeptRuling.description: The arbiter's ruling, as kept with its finding.

oneOf.description:
What breaks the work: a premise that does not hold, a case left out,
a simpler way.

The plan or the diff against the ticket's criteria, the decider's
answers and the project's rules.
What the change does to the code around it.

PullRequest.description: The pull request the runner opens for a finished ticket.

ResponseOutcome.description: What the author did with a finding.

ReviewPass.description: One review pass: the roster's findings on the plan or the diff.

findings.description:
The findings of every reviewer of the pass, ids increasing, at most
[`MAX_PASS_FINDINGS`].

pass.description: The pass at its stage, from 1.

reviewers.description:
The reviewers that ran the pass, in seat order, those that found
nothing included (OWL-304): what the DELIVERY report names.

Reviewer.description: The reviewer that raised a finding.

mandates.description: Its mandates, at least one, each once.

model.description: The model it ran on, as the harness was given it.

role.description: The reviewer's role: `design_review` or `verify`, the pass's stage.

same_model.description:
A reviewer on Claude Code that ran on the author's own model, no
other one being configured (OWL-304): the reports say so.

stand_in.description:
It stood in for a reviewer of another harness, such as the critic on
Claude Code without Codex.

Role.description: What a run executes: a stage's role, or one of the runner's helper roles.

Stage.description: A stage of the pipeline, or `ready` for an admitted ticket not yet started.
